review: 1:1 מִגְדַּל־עֻזִּי — Proverbs 18:10, the fixed glossary phrase, here with the 1cs suffix because the Arabic says 'my tower'.
2:2 פָּנָיו מְאִירוֹת — 'His face shines', the priestly blessing of Num 6:25; the Arabic الْبَسَّام ('smiling') is softened to the biblical idiom.

3:3–3:4 הֲיֵשׁ כָּמוֹהוּ / הוּא יְדִידִי — the Arabic has 'Has He a peer, my Master Christ / He is the intimate Friend'; Hebrew drops 'Christ' to keep ten syllables and keeps the confession in יְדִידִי.
4:1–4:3 — the Arabic calls sun, moons, heaven, earth and seas to praise (Ps 148); Hebrew keeps the same list and adds בְּנֵי הָאֱמוּנָה for 'sons of faith'.
